result:
Done, nothing in flight. The `/live/` feed is built and committed as `47a321ec0`, and the live-reload hold is released.

- **Render method:** `Live.draw()` in `public/live/Live.js` builds a `Live.Card` (a `Page` subclass) per item. The feed calls its `preview()`, which goes to the stock `Page.preview_card()` in `Previews.js`, and `Live.Card.full()` renders the full card.
- **Example line:** `{"type":"part-card","id":"example","title":"Full title","preview":"Short label","text":"Full **markdown** body"}`.
- **Check:** the feed at 400 and the full view at 1200 look right in headless shots. `check_page` errored on its URL argument, so I didn't use it.
- **Open:** at 1200 the full-view card is only about 600px wide, narrower than the gray column. I left that, since the owner is on mobile.
